scope: Existing staging testnet; unchanged SDK and NEAR-only harness; no new resources.
method: Sequential control/candidate/control, after all local builds and checks. Three fresh NEAR-only wallets and 21 verified signatures per arm. Existing staging resources only.

decision.reason: No repeatable end-to-end gain. Candidate median 3931.592 ms lies between baseline medians 4136.333 and 3588.747 ms. Remove the extra connection protocol and keep the existing baseline.

roundTrips.scope: Bound-root role-private D1 only, excluding root creation, other D1 operations and local DO SQL.
roundTrips.networkInteractionNote: The Router still waits for both readiness receipts and then sends a start message. Connection reuse reduces HTTP/object dispatches, not the logical prepare/start exchanges.
roundTrips.reason: One A connection spans preparation and execution. B still prepares independently. Root verification, conditional admission and fresh cancellation reads remain unchanged.

limitations: Three fresh wallets per arm; sequential conditions vary. These samples do not establish a percentile, guaranteed saving, or setup regression.
All local builds and E2Es finished before any hosted arm. Staging activation occurred before the first control.
Application clocks freeze during CPU work. Zero-millisecond B-start and JSON-decode spans do not mean zero CPU cost.
Fetch-to-headers spans include receiver processing, storage/output gates and transport. They do not isolate physical network time.
Actual Worker and DO execution locations were not measured. The existing authenticated APAC placement hints remain unchanged.
Six D1 calls and sixteen statements count only bound-root loads. Null Gateway counters are unavailable, not zero.
The new A object invocation covers both preparation and execution. Its whole-invocation CPU cannot be compared to the baseline preparation invocation alone.
The one-to-two-second hosted setup target remains unmet. The candidate is archived and removed from active dev sources.

reproduction.local: Build the five strict release Workers at the source commit, then run each localVerification command with ROUTER_AB_WORKER_BUILD_PROFILE=release.
reproduction.hosted: .artifacts/r155b-phase6n-hosted/run.py runs the frozen NEAR-only harness with guarded versions, candidate deployment after local verification, two controls and finally restoration.
